scope: Bounded read-only primary-source verification; two original conference PDFs were opened and relevant passages checked through web retrieval in this research thread. This artifact preserves that completed check, not a new hypothesis or experiment change.

sources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters
sections_checked: Discussion of multiple trials and significance testing
sources.evidence: Different training seeds with otherwise identical hyperparameters can produce markedly different performance. Figure 5 compares two groups of five runs. The paper cautions against favorable-trial selection and too few trials, and does not prescribe a universally sufficient seed count.
sources.relevance: Motivates checking whether the v21 continuation outcome persists across different continuation seeds while holding other settings fixed.
sources.limits: Not evidence that exactly three seeds are sufficient, and not a replication of this Isaac/PPO Ant experiment.

sources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
sections_checked: Section 4: Recommendations and Tools for Reliable Evaluation
sources.evidence: The formalism distinguishes independent training runs from tasks. In the Atari 100k study, 100 evaluation episodes are averaged into one run score. The paper advocates uncertainty-aware few-run reporting. Footnote 3 notes that a fixed seed may not control framework/GPU nondeterminism.
sources.relevance: Supports keeping training-run replication distinct from evaluation episode counts and reporting uncertainty rather than treating point estimates alone as conclusive.
sources.limits: The benchmark-wide statistical methodology is not a guarantee for three continuation seeds on one fixed-parent, fixed-terrain Ant setup.

design_inferences_not_paper_prescription: Three continuation seeds with a fixed parent checkpoint and fixed training terrain provide a descriptive sensitivity check conditional on that parent and terrain, not full initialization or training-distribution robustness.
Evaluation episodes, maps, and history-controller variants are not additional independent training replicates; 2960 evaluation episodes must not be reported as 2960 training replicates.
Exact seed-51 replay is an engineering compatibility gate, not a guarantee made by either paper. If exact, the historical seed-51 run and its replay are not an extra independent seed realization.

Report every prespecified seed and its paired differences against the common parent, without selecting the best seed. Three seeds alone do not establish broad significance or a causal mechanism for regression.
verification_limits: This is a literature provenance artifact, not verification of local experiment execution, results, or source code.
Original PDF URLs and relevant sections were verified; PDF file bytes were not saved or cryptographically pinned.
